decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records the second V height hierarchy and quiet supporting role, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The candidate already requires the É accent and Hero V terminal peaks to be exactly level; message 138 clarifies that existing alignment without changing the candidate state.
The shared-horizon instruction establishes a compositional relationship but does not explicitly alter the approved and locked Hero V geometry.
Message 138 positions the second V relative to the E and L but does not change the construction, terminal language, or case treatment of the E and L letterforms.
The source changes vertical composition and alignment, not the already established shared terminal geometry or exact Hero-derived terminal rule.
The hierarchy refinement concerns wordmark geometry and does not change the deferred champagne-gold material treatment.
The quiet-echo language applies the existing brand character to a specific typographic hierarchy but does not change the broader brand-expression requirement.
The source refines relationships within the wordmark without changing the decision to use a proprietary wordmark and no separate icon or monogram.
